newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific CFO leaves, successor named.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific CFO leaves, successor named.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines said on Tuesday that it has appointed George Leonard as chief financial officer after Martin Dugan resigned from the position.
Martin Dugan resigned as chief financial officer on Monday, said Sara Russell, a company spokeswoman.
The company said Dugan left "to pursue other business and personal interests."
Leonard has been working with Western Pacific for the past several months as a financial consultant, the company said.
Besides his new post, he will also serve on the board for a term that that expires in 1998, Western Pacific said.
